extDescription.message: Shows a translation below each lyric line on Spotify Web. The lines are sent to Google Translate.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser and in the add-on store (max. 132 characters).

permissionText.message: The extension needs access to Spotify Web and to the translator.

hint.message: Open the lyrics of a song on Spotify Web. The translation appears below each line.

optionsIntro.message: Replaces the colors Spotify generates from the album cover with your own colors or an image. Applies to the lyrics view (the side panel uses the background color), and changes show up right away.

imageError.message: Could not use this image. Try a JPG, PNG or WebP file.

imageTooLarge.message: This image is too large (max. 25 MB).

lowResCover.message: This image has a low resolution for your screen and may look blurry. The "Whole image" fit helps.

lowResContain.message: This image has a low resolution for your screen and may look a bit blurry.

imageLocalNote.message: The image stays only in this browser: it is not sent anywhere or synced to other devices.

previewPassed.message: A line that was already sung

disclaimer.message: Independent project, not affiliated with Spotify.
